sources.title: Kimi K3: 2.8T Open Model for Coding & Knowledge Work
sources.snippet: Meet Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter model with native vision and a 1M context window. Create playable games, polished slides, interactive reports, and more.

sources.title: Kimi K3: AI That Evolves With You - [2.8T Parameters & 1M Context]
